providers-eval-aifs-v1 result (apps/jane.measured: certs/janela-providers-eval-aifs.json, 2026-10-07: 3108 held-out pairs (2026-08-01..10-05), every option judged on the same ones. At Hs <= 2.0 m: U(E,N) 677 LIBERADA, 1 broken; U(E,N,A) 607 LIBERADA, 0 broken (coverage 0.9849); U(E,A) 694 LIBERADA, 1 broken; A alone 753 LIBERADA, 3 broken (coverage 0.9466); E alone 853 LIBERADA, 6 broken (0.9064); N alone 743 LIBERADA, 7 broken (0.8517 — under its claim on these months). The deterministic AIFS reads HIGH by 0.03-0.13 m, growing with lead, with an RMS at or just above IFS's to day 5 and below it at day 6; GFS-Wave reads low (-0.04 to -0.16 m).
providers-eval-aifs-v1 result (apps/jane.the rule applied: the three-band union does NOT meet the entry condition (10% fewer LIBERADA for one broken window fewer); U(E,A) meets the NECESSARY condition for replacing NOAA (17 more LIBERADA, one broken each)
providers-eval-aifs-v1 result (apps/jane.decision: providers-v1 STANDS (the union of IFS and NOAA decides). AIFS is committed and graded as two proposers (aifs-ens-c40of50, calibrated-aifs-v1), shown and never deciding. Why not replace NOAA now, by what Petrobras needs: (1) the margin is one broken window on each side in 2.2 months — no measured difference in the thing that matters first; (2) the union exists for robustness to one provider failing, and two models of one centre share its analysis, so U(E,A) is not two independent providers; (3) the AIFS band is calibrated on 4.7 months of one season. Re-asked, with this same rule, when the AIFS proposers reach their first admission look (30 trial days) and again after a summer of forward record.
